relatedStreams.title: Speaker's Unique Use of 'Alack' and Interactions with Fuwawa
relatedStreams.summaryOneLine: The speaker claims to be the only person who uses the word 'alack'. This assertion is supported by multiple statements, including 'because who the fuck says alack', 'me', 'that's who', and 'I'm the only person in the world'.
